# Ikon Smart TV IK-E500FF (Android TV 9 / 11, SDK 28-30).
# Fingerprint: IKON/ike500ff/ike500ff:9/PI/release-keys

# Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher / com.google.android.leanbacklauncher
# Live TV app: com.android.tv
# Kept on purpose: Google Play Services, Play Store, Chromecast, Live TV / HDMI input, Bluetooth remote.

# Content, ads and recommendation rows
com.google.android.tvrecommendations                # Home screen recommendation ad service
com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.recommendations # Leanback recommendation rows

# Telemetry and analytics

com.google.android.tv.bugreportsender               # Bug report uploader

# Preloaded apps

com.google.android.music                            # Google Play Music (discontinued)
com.google.android.videos                           # Google Play Movies & TV

# Retail demo mode (optional)

# Voice assistant (optional)
